name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures nginx as a multi-site web server for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, security headers, service management, and host hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configuring Redis authentication, port 6379, Fedora-specific runtime paths, logging, and related service settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from Git, creates its virtual environment and database, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
